real_editor_checks: Packed VSIX activates for .k and starts the real native server in a multi-root window
Go to definition follows an imported function to its source
Workspace references find unopened callers and respect the selected root
Rename reaches the editor as a checked workspace edit proposal
Partly typed expression names receive native completion
Imported record-field completion applies the full replacement range in VS Code
Enum completion uses EnumMember items and excludes already matched cases in VS Code
Record/update/enum payload labels preserve separators and exclude supplied fields in VS Code
Match payload completion preserves shorthand and explicit local bindings in VS Code
Member completions follow unsaved imported types without changing disk sources
Unsaved dependency edits recheck callers and clearing errors updates diagnostics
Format Document applies Unicode/CRLF edits, is idempotent and leaves disk files unchanged
Explicit project configuration restarts the native server and resolves package imports
Manual server restart restores checked editor features
completion_cases: Imported record fields replace whole partial identifiers with Field items
Enum constructors use EnumMember items and match cases exclude already selected variants
Record construction inserts a missing colon; updates and selected enum payloads preserve existing separators
Shorthand match payload labels stay shorthand and explicit binders keep their original names; both resulting local reads have checked types
Dot, brace and comma-triggered requests reach the native provider
Unsaved imported type changes update offered field labels; disk fixtures remain unchanged
qualification.applied_edits: Completion ranges and insertion strings checked, applied via WorkspaceEdit, then checked by native hover and cleared diagnostics
qualification.installed_profile: Isolated temporary VS Code profile/extension directory under ignored build/native/editor
qualification.host_loading: Installed VSIX loaded in the real VS Code Extension Development Host

limitations: Provider-command and applied-edit integration; manual suggestion-widget, keyboard-selection and accessibility UX are not qualified
Only VS Code 1.142.0 on macOS ARM64; other editors/platforms and Marketplace acceptance remain separate
No compiler/runtime or extension production behavior changed; general parser recovery and richer completion suggestions remain open
